name: Hecos MCP Store
description: Official catalog of MCP servers compatible with Hecos mcp_bridge.

mcp_servers.name: Filesystem
mcp_servers.description: Read and write files on the local filesystem. Gives Hecos access to any directory you specify.

mcp_servers.name: Fetch (Web Access)
mcp_servers.description: Lets Hecos fetch URLs and read web pages. Essential for web research.

mcp_servers.name: GitHub
mcp_servers.description: Browse repositories, issues, pull requests, and code on GitHub via the API.

mcp_servers.name: SQLite
mcp_servers.description: Query and manipulate a local SQLite database.

mcp_servers.name: Brave Search
mcp_servers.description: Perform web searches using the Brave Search API. Requires a free Brave API key.

mcp_servers.name: Google Drive
mcp_servers.description: Access and search Google Drive files. Requires Google OAuth credentials.

mcp_servers.name: Slack
mcp_servers.description: Read channels and send messages on Slack. Requires a Slack Bot Token.

mcp_servers.name: Memory (Knowledge Graph)
mcp_servers.description: A persistent knowledge graph. Lets Hecos remember facts about entities and their relationships.

mcp_servers.name: Puppeteer (Browser Automation)
mcp_servers.description: Control a real Chrome/Chromium browser. Hecos can take screenshots, navigate pages, and fill forms.

mcp_servers.name: PostgreSQL
mcp_servers.description: Connect to a PostgreSQL database and run SQL queries.
